description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_Token' which serves as a base class for various token types used in an HTML purification library. It includes properties for tracking source position, processing exemptions, and methods for property access and position management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token
classes.description: Abstract base class for tokens in the HTMLPurifier library, providing common properties and methods for derived token classes.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Deprecated getter accessing the 'type' of token based on class name; triggers a deprecation notice.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Sets the line and column position of the token in the source document.

methods.name: rawPosition
methods.description: Sets the line and column position, with special handling for column -1, during token processing.

methods.name: toNode
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to convert the token into a node representation.
